data.current_description:
Return a list of this site's events: every event name the site has tracked, plus any event you've set a currency for. Events are sorted by `name`.

**Permissions:** Requires read access to the site (`all-sites-readonly`, `read:{site_id}` or `manage:{site_id}`).

**Returns:** A list of event objects.

> Identify events by `name`. Goal IDs were removed on 24 September 2026, so don't store `id`. Only use it as the `starting_after` or `ending_before` cursor when you page through this list.

> `currency` is the currency you set with [Set event currency](#set-event-currency), or `null` when the event uses your site's default. `created_at` is `null` for newer events.
data.summary_suggestion: List all tracked events for a site
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves a paginated list of all events tracked on a site, including any events with custom currency settings. Events are sorted alphabetically by name. Each event object includes the event name, currency (if custom-set, otherwise null), and creation timestamp. Requires read access to the site. Use the `id` field only for pagination cursors (`starting_after` or `ending_before`), not for event identification—identify events by `name` instead.
data.reasoning: Original summary 'List events' is too generic. Description is comprehensive but could be more concise and better structured for AI agents. Added clarity about pagination, field usage, and identification method. Emphasized that `id` should only be used for pagination, not storage.
